[LCCO.8.2] The clause lowers to a sibling rule whose LHS is
`CallError error where error.corr == "<corr>" and <code-match-expr>`,
where `<code-match-expr>` is the dot-prefix predicate built from
the declared pattern. A clause without a pattern produces a
sibling rule whose `where` carries the correlation test alone; it
matches every error for the call.
